authorization: User explicitly approved expanding to stop-loss and take-profit. Prior user RR1:1.3-1.5 request retained for fixed-target alternatives.
baseline: unchanged original next-open market entry, no stop, moving SMA20 full exit
data_inputs: reuse original cached features after hashes and raw Bars.dat stat checks
entry_rules: original confirmed preparation/BB-return signal and exclusions; market next available open OR limit=signal_close-side*signal_priorATR, valid next 3 available bars
pending_cancel: Limit only: previous-confirmed center reached at open cancels before fill. No limit fill + intrabar center touch cancels. After unfilled bar: ttl third bar, gap, same-side impulse/long-wick, opposite band touch or close crossing newly confirmed center cancels future order. Current close cancellation cannot erase an earlier fill. No cancellation-bar rearming. Pending center updates at each surviving close even for future fixed-RR target cases.
stop_rules: 5 pip, 10 pip, or 1.5*priorATR at original signal; risk ticks=max(1,ceil(raw risk/tick)); actual risk=ticks*tick; SL=actual_entry-side*actual risk. Fixed during holding; active from entry bar.
target_rules: moving center from previously confirmed bar OR fixed RR1.3/1.5 from actual entry; fixed reward ticks=max(1,ceil(risk_ticks*RR)); TP=actual_entry+side*rewardticks*tick. Quantized actual RR >= requested gross RR, differs by <1 reward tick. No costs embedded in prices.
bar_fill_order: First open-gap stop then open-gap target; otherwise touched stop first, then target. Intrabar limit fill suppresses all samebar TP, but stop remains live; open fill allows ordinary SL/TP. All costs deducted once on full exit.
ambiguity_reporting: Count intrabar limit-entry bars where actual TP was also touched; separately count any position-bar with both stop and target touches. Counts are diagnostics not independent samples or a guaranteed worst-case P/L bound.
period_semantics: independent flat yearly portfolios with pre-period warmup; continuous full period separately; no forced final exit in PF, separately report cost-adjusted open mark and net+open
final_period_prior_exposure: all three years previously viewed, not untouched holdout
cost_and_fill_model: fixed 1.4pips and metadata spread/pip+0.2pips; no variable spreads/swaps/queue/liquidity; ideal limit touch fills; raw OHLC prices and one cost debit
position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed-unit position per pair; equal-pip research score NOT money
selection: nonbaseline training only: both cost cases net>0 and net+open>0, >=40 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs; rank minimum train net across costs descending then id ascending; at most one candidate; no later fallback
evaluation_access: all candidates train only; selected plus baseline only validation/final/continuous; none selected => baseline alone later
acceptance_gates: both costs: each evaluated period positive net and net+open; continuous >=100 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs; final >=30 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs
cross_symbol_rule: same candidate for all nine; no winning-symbol postselection
code_identifier: runner records frozen protocol/source/cache/manifest SHA256 before outcomes
stop_rule: 19 total candidates only; no positive training candidate or later gate failure => REJECTED; no expansion in this experiment
